about: I am a photographer and visual artist who spent 20 years in New York before moving to Colorado. Compared to what I had known before, it felt like moving to the edge of civilization. However, relocating my home here has empowered me to become more authentically myself.
My work playfully explores the mundane and overlooked. I strive to create meaningful work by producing long-term documentary projects.
I look to capture a quiet stillness; turning everyday spaces into permanent records of a transient world.
It appeared that there was nothing there, but the more I slow down, the more I see.
